::: {#def-prediction-mse}
#### Mean squared error of predictions

The **sample mean squared error (sMSE)** of predictions,
also called their **mean squared error**,
$\dsn{\fitted}$
of observed outcomes $\dsn{y}$
is the mean of their squared [prediction errors](#def-prediction-error) [@wikipedia_mean_squared_prediction_error]:

$$\sMSE{\fitted} \eqdef \avgin \prederr_\iobs^2.$$

Source: @wikipedia_mean_squared_prediction_error.
:::
